lint.command: helm lint --strict deploy/helm/aip && for f in deploy/helm/aip/ci/*.yaml; do helm lint --strict deploy/helm/aip -f "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in "" deploy/helm/aip/ci/*.yaml; do helm template aip deploy/helm/aip -n aip ${f:+-f "$f"} | kubeconform -strict -summary -kubernetes-version 1.29.0 || exit 1; done
